record_scope_reconstruction: The dispute concerned the local Three Pagodas/Payathonzu gate beside the Thai road/drain works. It affected commuters and visitors; September evidence says large goods still restricted, so commuter reopening is not a full cargo reopening.

source_checks.finding: KIC July 28 report describes road-drain works, flooding into Payathonzu and Myanmar closure of the local border checkpoint.
KIC retrospective says commuters resumed after July 26 talks, with large goods still restricted.
Thai PBS July 27 text says gate would reopen that day after a full-day restriction; no exact clock confirmed.
